title: Free to Play
summary: Valve's feature-length documentary following three professional gamers competing in the first Dota 2 International tournament for a million dollar prize. It shows the sacrifices and pressures of top-level esports.
why: HN recommends it as an engaging look at the life of pro Dota players and the early rise of esports, though one commenter notes it is somewhat promotional.

quote.text: I've enjoyed this documentary a lot.
